_globalTranslations.appDescription: Book unforgettable stays with a friendly ghostly twist.

heroPanel.title: Why travelers love Ghostbnb
heroPanel.body: From moonlit cottages to whispering lofts, discover character-filled homes hosted by locals and their cheerful resident spirits.

card1.title: Stay in Legendary Homes
card1.body: Sleep in castles, lighthouses, and manors with stories older than the maps.

card2.title: Hosts With Character
card2.body: Meet superhosts who pair modern comfort with curated ghostly folklore.

card3.title: Memories, Not Jump Scares
card3.body: Every stay is reviewed for charm, safety, and unforgettable midnight ambiance.

highlights.title: Guest Favorites
highlights.item1: Late-night tea sessions in candlelit libraries.
highlights.item2: Rooftop views with gentle phantom footsteps.
highlights.item3: Locally curated guides to eerie neighborhood gems.

news.title: From the Community
news.body: This month, our hosts opened 12 newly restored heritage homes for brave weekend travelers.

quote.text: "We came for the architecture, stayed for the midnight piano music, and left with the best travel story of our year."
quote.author: Mara, Superguest

cta.text: Ready for your next beautifully haunted getaway?
